The hash is the keccak of the concatenation of the individual EIP-712 hashes of the Module transactions. Requirements:

# Kleric DAO Proposal Acceptance Criteria
In order for KlericDao's SnapSafe module to execute a transaction, any corresponding proposal must have passed, as reported by Reality.eth.

Reality.eth should resolve the question to **“yes”** only for proposals that:
- were initiated as a Snapshot proposal in the `kleric.eth` Snapshot space.
- the module transaction hash in the Reality.eth question is the keccak hash of the concatenation of the individual EIP-712 hashes of the module transactions defined in the Snapshot proposal.
- the plain description of the transactions, and their intended result, in the proposal is complete and accurate.
- did not occur during, in, or as a result of any unauthorized or malicious changes to the kleric.eth Snapshot space.
- were not filtered from the default view in the kleric.eth Snapshot space during the voting period.
- Allocate 90% of the funds for funding appeals on the challenger's side for cases 160-181 on the Gnosis Chain.
- Allow 10% of the funds to be sent to address 0xF1133aDFA85267a40d1800eA26c01a97d28dB21C to cover fees.
- Distribute any remaining proceeds to contributors in proportion to their contribution, in the event of a successful appeal.
- Refund any remaining funds to contributors if they are not used for appeals.

Separate Clause:
- If all cases (160-181) have ended and kleric.eth is unresponsive, any individual may initiate a distribution of the remaining funds to contributors according to their proportional contribution.

Reality.eth should resolve the question to **“invalid”** if:
- the Reality.eth question meets the above requirements but was created prior to the end of the proposal vote period and/or the snapshot block for the vote. i.e. the final results of the vote are not yet known.

In all other cases, the Reality.eth question should be resolved to **“no”**.""}
